# Best Speech-to-Text and Transcription Models

Model rankings updated October 2026 based on real usage data.

Models are ranked by total transcribed characters processed through the OpenRouter API over the trailing 7 days. Showing the top 25 models. Rankings measure usage on OpenRouter and reflect adoption, not model quality or benchmark performance.

Speech-to-text models convert spoken audio into text for transcription, captions, meeting summaries, call analysis, and voice-driven applications. This collection ranks transcription models by their usage on OpenRouter over the past week. The current top models are MAI-Transcribe 2, Whisper Large V3 Turbo, and Whisper Large V3. Compare accuracy, speed, language support, and cost to match the right model to your audio workflow.

[Browse All Models](https://openrouter.ai/models) [Compare Models](https://openrouter.ai/compare)

## Top Speech-to-Text Models on OpenRouter

[![Favicon for microsoft](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/MAI.png)\\
\\
**Microsoft AI: MAI-Transcribe 2**](https://openrouter.ai/microsoft/mai-transcribe-2)

19.4B characters

MAI-Transcribe 2 is a multilingual speech-to-text model from Microsoft AI, ranked #1 on the FLEURS multilingual benchmark. It supports 60 languages with automatic language identification, code switching for mixed-language speech, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, keyword biasing for domain-specific terminology, and configurable verbatim or clean transcription styles. It is suited for captions, call transcription, subtitling, accessibility, and other voice-enabled applications, and is faster than MAI-Transcribe-1.5 on long-form audio.

On OpenRouter, set `response_format` to `"verbose_json"` for segment timestamps, and add `timestamp_granularities: ["word"]` for word-level timestamps. Set `provider.options.azure.diarization.enabled` to `true` for speaker labels, provide keywords through `provider.options.azure.phraseList.phrases`, and select a transcription style through `provider.options.azure.enhancedMode.modelOptions.transcribeStyle`. See the speech-to-text guide.

by [microsoft](https://openrouter.ai/microsoft)$0.10/hour

[![Favicon for openai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/OpenAI.svg)\\
\\
**OpenAI: Whisper Large V3 Turbo**](https://openrouter.ai/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo)

4.88B characters

Whisper Large V3 Turbo is an optimized version of OpenAI's Whisper Large V3 speech recognition model, designed for speed and cost efficiency. It supports transcription across 99+ languages with a 12% word error rate, and accepts common audio formats including mp3, mp4, wav, webm, flac, and ogg. Achieves real-time speed factors up to 216x, making it well-suited for latency-sensitive and high-throughput transcription workloads.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$0.000003/second

[![Favicon for openai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/OpenAI.svg)\\
\\
**OpenAI: Whisper Large V3**](https://openrouter.ai/openai/whisper-large-v3)

1.61B characters

Whisper Large V3 is OpenAI's open-source automatic speech recognition model offering both audio transcription and translation. It supports 99+ languages and accepts common audio formats including mp3, mp4, wav, webm, flac, and ogg. With 1,550M parameters, it achieves a 10.3% word error rate and is well-suited for noise-robust, multilingual transcription in demanding conditions. Supports timestamp granularities at word and segment levels.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$0.000008/second

1.3B characters

ElevenLabs Scribe v2 is a speech-to-text model that transcribes audio in 90+ languages with word-level timestamps, optional speaker diarization, and audio-event tagging.

by [elevenlabs](https://openrouter.ai/elevenlabs)$0.000061/second

[![Favicon for openai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/OpenAI.svg)\\

340M characters

GPT-4o Mini Transcribe is OpenAI's smaller, cost-efficient speech-to-text model built on GPT-4o Mini audio capabilities. It's priced per token (input and output), making it suitable for high-volume transcription workflows that benefit from token-level billing transparency at a lower cost point.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$1.25/Minputtokens$5/Moutputtokens

**SpaceXAI: Grok STT 1.0**](https://openrouter.ai/x-ai/grok-stt-1.0)

218M characters

Grok STT is SpaceXAI's speech-to-text model, available via the REST /v1/stt endpoint. It supports transcription with word-level timestamps, optional speaker diarization, and multichannel audio.

by [x-ai](https://openrouter.ai/x-ai)$0.000028/second

[![Favicon for openai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/OpenAI.svg)\\

**OpenAI: Whisper 1**](https://openrouter.ai/openai/whisper-1)

174M characters

Whisper is OpenAI's open-source automatic speech recognition model, available via API as `whisper-1`. It supports transcription and translation across 50+ languages from audio files up to 25 MB. Accepts formats including mp3, mp4, wav, and webm. Priced per minute of audio duration, billed to the nearest second.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$0.0001/second

156M characters

Qwen3 ASR 1.7B is an automatic speech recognition model from Qwen. It supports multilingual language identification and transcription across 30 languages and 22 Chinese dialects, with streaming and offline inference plus segment-level and word-level timestamps.

by [qwen](https://openrouter.ai/qwen)$0.000008/second

**OpenAI: GPT Transcribe**](https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-transcribe)

121M characters

GPT Transcribe is a high-accuracy speech-to-text model from OpenAI. It is suited for recorded audio, streamed file transcription, and committed Realtime turns, with free-form context, keyword hints, and multiple language hints for specialized terms and multilingual speech.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$0.000075/second

[![Favicon for deepgram](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/Deepgram.svg)\\

**Deepgram: Nova-3**](https://openrouter.ai/deepgram/nova-3)

103M characters

Deepgram Nova-3 general-purpose speech-to-text model with monolingual and multilingual transcription support.

by [deepgram](https://openrouter.ai/deepgram)from $0.000072/second

[![Favicon for nvidia](https://t0.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https://nvidia.com/&size=256)\\

**NVIDIA: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3**](https://openrouter.ai/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3)

90.4M characters

Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 is NVIDIA's 600M-parameter multilingual speech-to-text model built on the FastConformer-TDT architecture. Trained on the Granary dataset (670,000+ hours of audio), it supports automatic language detection across all official EU languages and achieves a 6.34% average word error rate on the HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard. Returns transcribed text with punctuation and segment timestamps.

by [nvidia](https://openrouter.ai/nvidia)$0.000025/second

[![Favicon for mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/Mistral.png)\\

89.1M characters

Voxtral Mini Transcribe is Mistral's speech-to-text model, derived from the Voxtral Mini family. It accepts audio input and returns transcribed text via the standard transcription API. Suited for transcribing meetings, voice notes, podcasts, and other spoken content.

by [mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/mistralai)$0.00005/second

[![Favicon for nvidia](https://t0.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https://nvidia.com/&size=256)\\

**NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming Multilingual 0.6B**](https://openrouter.ai/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-multilingual-0.6b)

81.5M characters

Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming Multilingual 0.6B is a speech recognition model from NVIDIA. Its prompt-conditioned, cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT design targets low-latency transcription across more than 40 languages for real-time captioning, voice agents, and multilingual transcription pipelines.

by [nvidia](https://openrouter.ai/nvidia)$0.000003/second

[![Favicon for google](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/GoogleGemini.svg)\\

**Google: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**](https://openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3.5-transcribe)

77.6M characters

Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is a speech-to-text model from Google. It is suited for synchronous transcription that needs word-level timestamps or speaker diarization, with support for up to eight speakers. Audio can be up to one hour, or 30 minutes when timestamps or diarization are enabled.

by [google](https://openrouter.ai/google)$2/Minputtokens$12/Moutputtokens

75.5M characters

by [elevenlabs](https://openrouter.ai/elevenlabs)$0.000061/second

by [qwen](https://openrouter.ai/qwen)$0.000003/second

[![Favicon for mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/Mistral.png)\\

**Mistral: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3**](https://openrouter.ai/mistralai/voxtral-small-transcribe-3-0)

43M characters

Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 is Mistral's flagship speech-to-text model. It takes audio input and returns a transcript with timestamps and speaker diarization, and supports context biasing for domain-specific vocabulary. Suited for high-accuracy multilingual transcription of meetings, interviews, media, and support calls.

by [mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/mistralai)$0.000067/second

GPT-4o Transcribe is OpenAI's high-quality speech-to-text model built on GPT-4o audio capabilities. It's priced per token (input and output), making it suitable for workflows that benefit from token-level billing transparency.

by [openai](https://openrouter.ai/openai)$2.50/Minputtokens$10/Moutputtokens

[![Favicon for assemblyai](https://t0.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https://www.assemblyai.com/&size=256)\\

**AssemblyAI: Universal-3.5 Pro**](https://openrouter.ai/assemblyai/universal-3-5-pro)

28.3M characters

Universal-3.5 Pro is AssemblyAI's speech-to-text model served through its Sync API, returning a complete transcript with word-level timestamps in a single synchronous response for audio up to 20 minutes. It accepts WAV and compressed input (MP3, M4A, AAC, Ogg/Opus, FLAC, and WebM) and supports free-text prompting, keyterms, and conversation context to steer transcription toward domain vocabulary.

by [assemblyai](https://openrouter.ai/assemblyai)from $0.000083/second

[![Favicon for fish-audio](https://t0.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https://fish.audio/&size=256)\\

**Fish Audio: Transcribe 1 Pro**](https://openrouter.ai/fish-audio/transcribe-1-pro)

22.3M characters

Transcribe 1 Pro is a speech-to-text model from Fish Audio tuned for interviews, meetings, and podcasts. It labels speakers with inline `speaker` markers, preserves emotion and vocal-event cues such as `[laughter]`, detects language automatically, and can return timestamped word-level segments.

by [fish-audio](https://openrouter.ai/fish-audio)$0.0001/second

[![Favicon for assemblyai](https://t0.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https://www.assemblyai.com/&size=256)\\
\\
**AssemblyAI: Universal-3.6 Pro**](https://openrouter.ai/assemblyai/universal-3-6-pro)

16.3M characters

Universal-3.6 Pro is AssemblyAI's speech-to-text model and the successor to Universal-3.5 Pro, served here through AssemblyAI's Sync API. Compared with Universal-3.5 Pro, AssemblyAI reports 30% fewer errors on short conversational utterances, 12% fewer errors on average across supported languages, 14 newly supported languages, and better recognition and formatting of entities such as phone numbers, addresses, emails, and codes. It returns a complete transcript with word-level timestamps in a single synchronous response for audio up to 20 minutes, accepts WAV and compressed input (MP3, M4A, AAC, Ogg/Opus, FLAC, and WebM), and supports free-text prompting, keyterms, and conversation context to steer transcription toward domain vocabulary.

by [assemblyai](https://openrouter.ai/assemblyai)from $0.000083/second

[![Favicon for mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/Mistral.png)\\
\\
**Mistral: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3**](https://openrouter.ai/mistralai/voxtral-mini-transcribe-3-0)

13M characters

Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 is Mistral's compact speech-to-text model. It takes audio input and returns a transcript with timestamps and speaker diarization. It also supports context biasing for domain terms. It is small enough to self-deploy in resource-constrained environments, and fits meeting notes, call analytics, and voice-agent pipelines where cost matters.

by [mistralai](https://openrouter.ai/mistralai)$0.000058/second

[![Favicon for microsoft](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/MAI.png)\\
\\
**Microsoft AI: MAI-Transcribe 1.5**](https://openrouter.ai/microsoft/mai-transcribe-1.5)

9.2M characters

MAI-Transcribe 1.5 is a multilingual speech-to-text model from Microsoft AI. It is suited for captions, call transcription, subtitling, accessibility, and other voice-enabled applications, with reliable transcription across 43 languages, diverse accents, and noisy real-world audio. It supports automatic language identification and keyword biasing for domain-specific terminology, and improves long-form transcription speed over MAI-Transcribe-1. Speaker diarization is not supported.

by [microsoft](https://openrouter.ai/microsoft)$0.36/hour

[![Favicon for google](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/GoogleGemini.svg)\\
\\
**Google: Chirp 3**](https://openrouter.ai/google/chirp-3)

6.61M characters

Chirp 3 is Google's latest multilingual speech-to-text model. It offers enhanced transcription accuracy across 24 GA languages and 77+ preview languages, with support for automatic language detection, automatic punctuation, and a built-in denoiser for cleaner audio processing.

by [google](https://openrouter.ai/google)$0.000267/second

[![Favicon for meta](https://openrouter.ai/images/icons/Meta.png)\\
\\
**Meta: Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0**](https://openrouter.ai/meta/muse-voice-transcribe-1.0)

5.05M characters

Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 is a synchronous speech-to-text model from Meta. It is suited for push-to-talk, endpointing, and speaker-aware transcription, with keyword biasing for domain terms and language biasing through language-name hints. It accepts mono 16-bit PCM WAV audio at 16 kHz or 24 kHz for recordings up to 10 minutes. It does not provide word-level timestamps or confidence scores, and other audio formats must be converted to WAV before upload.

by [meta](https://openrouter.ai/meta)$0.00005/second
